title.text: Embassy Suites by Hilton Dubai Business Bay

pills.label: In 15:00 · out 12:00
pills.pop_html: Check-in and out: Check-in from 15:00, check-out until 12:00. The minimum check-in age is 18 and the hotel takes cards only, no cash.

pills.label: 34 m² King Guest Room
pills.pop_html: Cheapest room: The €186 rate is the King Guest Room (366 ft², about 34 m²) with an extra-large double bed, city view, bath, minibar and coffee maker. Corner King Rooms with Burj Khalifa view start at €191.

pills.label: Kids' buffet + play areas
pills.pop_html: Families: Children of any age are welcome, cots are free for 0–2 years and an extra bed costs AED 120 a night from age 11. Indoor and outdoor play areas plus a children's buffet. Rooms are wheelchair accessible, with a Queen Room built for mobility access.

pills.label: Breakfast included
pills.pop_html: Breakfast: The €186 card rate already includes breakfast for two, with free cancellation and pay at the property. Breakfast has fresh pastries, pancakes and fruit.

pills.label: Infinity pool
pills.pop_html: Pool and spa: Year-round outdoor infinity pool, spa and wellness centre with massage and sauna, and a fitness room.

pills.label: Burj Khalifa suites
pills.pop_html: Upgrade worth knowing: One-bedroom suites with two double beds and Burj Khalifa view (527 ft²) and Superior King Suites up to 743 ft² with a sofa bed in the living room.

pills.label: Polished family base
pills.pop_html: Vibe: A big-brand 5-star on Marasi Drive with 3 restaurants, free private parking and a 9.5 for comfort and staff.

best_for.pick_html: for couples and families who want breakfast, free cancellation and an infinity pool in one €186 rate from a 5-star with a 9.2 score.
best_for.skip_html: if you want a kitchen: rooms have a minibar and coffee maker only, so look at #4 or #5.

items.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?

Spa and wellness centre, massage, sauna, fitness room.

pills.label: In 15:00 · out 12:00
pills.pop_html: Check-in and out: Check-in 15:00 to midnight, check-out 08:00 to 12:00. Photo ID and a credit card at check-in, plus a refundable AED 200 (about €49) damage deposit. Cards only.

pills.label: 30 m² canal view
pills.pop_html: Cheapest room: The €91 rate is a Standard Room Canal View (323 ft², about 30 m²) with an extra-large double bed, minibar and seating area. It bundles 20% off food and drink, 20% off laundry and 10% off the spa.

pills.label: Kids from 1 year
pills.pop_html: Families: Children older than 1 year are welcome; from 13 they are charged as adults. Extra beds AED 100 a night for ages 1–11. Wheelchair accessible with grab rails and a raised toilet.

pills.label: Rooftop pool
pills.pop_html: Pool and spa: Heated rooftop pool with a pool bar, plus a spa with sauna, steam room and massage.

pills.label: Breakfast €17
pills.pop_html: Breakfast: Breakfast is €17, the cheapest add-on of any hotel here that shows a price. The Food Souk restaurant serves breakfast and lunch.

pills.label: 3 km to Burj Khalifa
pills.pop_html: Distances: Burj Khalifa is 3 km away, The Dubai Fountain 3.1 km and Jumeirah Beach Park 3 km. Dubai International is 15 km; a paid airport shuttle is available.

pills.label: Smart-money pick
pills.pop_html: Vibe: A 4-star that scores like a 5-star: 9.0 overall and 9.4 for staff, at half the price of the luxury picks.

best_for.pick_html: for couples who want a canal-view room, a rooftop pool and a 9.0 score for €91, with breakfast at €17.
best_for.skip_html: if you want a big room, a bath or dinner on site: the standard room is 30 m² with a shower, and the Food Souk restaurant serves breakfast and lunch only.

pills.label: In 15:00 · out 12:00
pills.pop_html: Check-in and out: Check-in from 15:00, check-out until 12:00. Photo ID and credit card at check-in, and a refundable AED 750 (about €185) deposit on the card. Guests must be 18 to 90.

pills.label: 46 m² with balcony
pills.pop_html: Cheapest room: Signature King Room with balcony (the €212 rate) or Signature Duo Beds with balcony, both 495 ft² (about 46 m²), with walk-in shower and bath, soundproofing and minibar.

pills.label: Kids welcome
pills.pop_html: Families: Children of any age; from 12 they pay as adults. Free cots on request; extra beds AED 150 a night. Pets allowed on request.

pills.label: 2 pools, rooftop infinity
pills.pop_html: Pools: Two pools including a rooftop infinity pool with pool bar, plus a hot tub. Yoga classes and wellness packages.

pills.label: 7 restaurants
pills.pop_html: Dining: Seven restaurants on site including Fi'lia (Italian, Mediterranean) and Carna steakhouse, plus a rooftop bar. Breakfast is a buffet; breakfast-included and half-board rates exist.

pills.label: Full spa
pills.pop_html: Spa: Spa and wellness centre with massage, steam room and hot tub.

pills.label: Rooftop glamour
pills.pop_html: Vibe: Big views, a nightlife-ready rooftop and some of the largest entry rooms here, at a 9.3 location score.

best_for.pick_html: for couples who want the big-night version of Business Bay: 46 m² balcony rooms, a rooftop infinity pool and seven restaurants for €212.
best_for.skip_html: if you need breakfast in the price: the €212 rate is room only, and the breakfast-included rate is non-refundable.

pills.label: In 15:00 · out 12:00
pills.pop_html: Check-in and out: Check-in from 15:00, check-out until 12:00, with private and express check-in. No age restriction for check-in.

pills.label: 48 m² studio + kitchen
pills.pop_html: Cheapest room: Studio King Room with Kitchenette and City View, 517 ft² (about 48 m²): stovetop, oven, fridge and kitchenware, plus a bathroom with bath, shower and bidet.

pills.label: Kids' pool, free cots
pills.pop_html: Families: Children of any age; free cots for 0–2, extra beds AED 150 a night. Kids' pool. Wheelchair accessible with lower sink and grab rails.

pills.label: Heated rooftop infinity pool
pills.pop_html: Pool: Rooftop infinity pool, heated, with a pool bar. Sauna, garden and terrace.

pills.label: Breakfast €37
pills.pop_html: Breakfast: €37, or pick a breakfast-included rate (from €234 a night). The all-day Mediterranean restaurant does breakfast, lunch and dinner.

pills.label: Free bikes
pills.pop_html: Extras: Free bicycles, airport shuttle, valet parking with EV charging.

pills.label: Highest score here
pills.pop_html: Vibe: Polished residences with a 9.5 overall and 9.7 for cleanliness and comfort, the top marks of all ten.

best_for.pick_html: for longer stays, families and anyone who wants a 48 m² studio with a real kitchen inside a 5-star with the highest guest score of the ten (9.5).
best_for.skip_html: if you want a buzzy hotel with many restaurants: there is one all-day restaurant, so SLS (#3), also on Marasi Drive, suits nightlife better.

pills.label: In 15:00 · out 12:00
pills.pop_html: Check-in and out: Check-in 15:00 to midnight (tell them your arrival time), check-out 09:00 to 12:00. AED 400 (about €99) damage deposit in cash on arrival, refunded at check-out.

pills.label: 41 m² studio, balcony
pills.pop_html: Cheapest room: Studio with Balcony, 441 ft² (about 41 m²), large double bed, city view, private kitchen, dishwasher, soundproofing. One-bedroom apartments are 807 ft².

pills.label: Free cots, no extra beds
pills.pop_html: Families: Children of any age; free cots for 0–3. No extra beds, but there is a One-Bedroom Family Apartment. No parties, no smoking, no pets.

pills.label: Rooftop infinity pool
pills.pop_html: Pool: Heated rooftop infinity pool open all year, sun terrace, steam room and fitness room.

pills.label: Washer + dishwasher
pills.pop_html: Living: Washing machine, dishwasher, kitchenette and sofa bed, daily housekeeping, and a minimarket in the building.

pills.label: Free parking
pills.pop_html: Extras: Free private parking on site; in-room breakfast (continental, Italian, American) to order.

pills.label: Missoni-designed home
pills.pop_html: Vibe: A designer apartment tower with a 9.3 score and 9.3 for value, the best value score of the ten.

best_for.pick_html: for couples staying 4+ nights who want a Missoni-designed studio with a balcony, washing machine and rooftop infinity pool for €129.
best_for.skip_html: if you want a spa and a choice of restaurants: this is an apartment building with a steam room, a fitness room and in-room breakfast, not a full-service hotel.

pills.pop_html: Check-in and out: Check-in 15:00 to 23:30, check-out 12:00 to 12:30. AED 700 (about €173) damage deposit on your credit card, refunded within 14 days.

pills.label: 38 m² studio + kitchenette
pills.pop_html: Cheapest room: Studio City View with kitchenette, 409 ft² (about 38 m²), large double bed, coffee machine. Canal-view and panorama-view studios are the same size; one-bedrooms are 667 ft².

pills.label: Kids' club + games room
pills.pop_html: Families: Children of any age; free cots up to age 3, extra beds AED 180 a night. Kids' club, children's play room and a games room.

pills.label: 3 outdoor pools
pills.pop_html: Pools: Three outdoor pools open all year, the most of any property here.

pills.label: Gaming studio option
pills.pop_html: Extras: A Studio Level Up rate includes free half-day gaming centre access. Spa and fitness centre on site.

pills.label: Sheikh Zayed Road
pills.pop_html: Location: At AYKON City on Sheikh Zayed Road, the edge of Business Bay. Free private parking; paid airport shuttle; 16 km to the airport.

pills.label: Big family tower
pills.pop_html: Vibe: The most-reviewed property on this list, with a 9.0 score and 9.3 for cleanliness and free WiFi.

best_for.pick_html: for families with kids who want a kitchenette studio, three pools and a kids' club for €130 a night.
best_for.skip_html: if you want to walk the canal: AYKON City sits on Sheikh Zayed Road, not on Marasi Drive like #1, #3, #4, #5 and #7.

pills.pop_html: Check-in and out: Check-in from 15:00, check-out until 12:00, photo ID and credit card required. Cards only, minimum age 18.

pills.label: City or Downtown view
pills.pop_html: Cheapest room: Standard King Room with City View (from €109) or a twin room with Downtown view, both with a pool view, walk-in shower and minibar.

pills.label: Pets welcome
pills.pop_html: Families and pets: Children of any age; from 13 they pay as adults. Free cots for 0–6, extra beds AED 130 a night from 12. Pets are allowed (charges may apply), with pet basket and bowls. Wheelchair accessible.

pills.label: Breakfast €34
pills.pop_html: Breakfast: €34, or breakfast-included rates. Open Sesame serves Mediterranean and Middle Eastern food from breakfast to cocktails, with high tea.

pills.label: Pool with a view
pills.pop_html: Pool and spa: Outdoor pool with a pool bar, a paid spa with steam room, massage and beauty treatments.

pills.label: Colourful boutique
pills.pop_html: Vibe: Colourful interiors and a 9.4 for comfort and staff. Despite the name, it is on Marasi Drive in Business Bay.

best_for.pick_html: for couples who want a 5-star boutique hotel with character for €109, or anyone travelling with a pet (basket and bowls provided).
best_for.skip_html: if breakfast must be cheap: at €34 it costs double Park Regis (#2).

pills.label: Superior + Palm beach
pills.pop_html: Cheapest room: Superior Room City View (double or twin) with bath, shower and bathrobes. The room rate includes free access to the hotel's private beach on Palm Jumeirah.

pills.label: Kids' pool + play area
pills.pop_html: Families: Children of any age; free cots for 0–3, extra beds AED 100 a night for ages 6–12 and AED 180 for adults. Kids' pool and indoor play area.

pills.label: Free Palm beach access
pills.pop_html: Beach: Business Bay has no beach, but this room type comes with free access to the hotel's private beach on Palm Jumeirah.

pills.label: 2 heated pools
pills.pop_html: Pools: Two outdoor pools with a view, one for kids, heated, with a pool bar. Spa, steam room and bicycle rental.

pills.label: Family 5-star
pills.pop_html: Vibe: A 5-star with three restaurants, including Lilly's Social House, and a 9.4 for staff.

best_for.pick_html: for families and beach lovers who want a 5-star base in Business Bay for €121 with free access to a private beach on the Palm.
best_for.skip_html: if you want to walk to the sand: the free beach is on Palm Jumeirah, a drive away, and the listing names no shuttle to it.

pills.label: 25 m² Deluxe Room
pills.pop_html: Cheapest room: Deluxe Room, 269 ft² (about 25 m²), large double bed, pool, landmark and city views, soundproofing, minibar.

pills.label: Adults 21+ to check in
pills.pop_html: Families: Children of any age; free cots for 0–3, extra beds for adults AED 100 a night. The main guest must be 21. Wheelchair accessible.

pills.label: Free Dubai Mall shuttle
pills.pop_html: Getting around: The rate includes complimentary shuttles to Dubai Mall and Kite Beach, plus 20% off food and drink and 10% off laundry.

pills.label: Rooftop pool

pills.label: Easy-going value

best_for.skip_html: if you need space or are under 21: rooms are 25 m² and the main guest must be 21 to check in.

pills.label: In 15:00 · out 12:00
pills.pop_html: Check-in and out: Check-in 15:00 to 22:00 (tell them your arrival time), check-out 06:00 to 12:00. AED 500 (about €123) card deposit, refunded at check-out.

pills.label: 47 m² Deluxe
pills.pop_html: Cheapest room: Deluxe Always ME, 47 m², king bed, city and landmark view, rain shower and bathtub, sound system. A Burj Khalifa view version is available.

pills.label: No extra beds
pills.pop_html: Families: Children welcome, but only cots for under-1s; no extra beds. Pets allowed on request. Wheelchair accessible.

pills.label: Zaha Hadid's Opus
pills.pop_html: The building: The hotel is inside The Opus, designed by Zaha Hadid.

pills.label: 6 restaurants incl. Roka
pills.pop_html: Dining: Six venues including Roka (Japanese), The MAINE Land Brasserie and Central Cosmo Tapas & Bar. Breakfast is à la carte.

pills.label: 2.4 km to Dubai Mall
pills.pop_html: Distances: Burj Khalifa 2 km, The Dubai Fountain 1.7 km, Dubai Mall 2.4 km, airport 15 km (paid shuttle).

pills.label: Architecture splurge
pills.pop_html: Vibe: For guests who want to stay inside a landmark, with a heated outdoor pool, spa and 9.5 for WiFi.

best_for.pick_html: for design lovers who want to sleep inside Zaha Hadid's Opus in a 47 m² room, 1.7 km from The Dubai Fountain.
best_for.skip_html: if value matters: at €290 it is the priciest here and scores 8.8, below SLS (#3) at €212.
